results.content: Pope Leo XIV was welcomed by crowds in Claypole, near Buenos Aires, as he visited the Don Orione care home. The pontiff greeted the faithful and unveiled a plaque during his 12-day South American tour.

results.title: Norway dropped from junior hockey championship to make room for Russia
results.content: The IIHF has moved Norway, ranked 10th, to Division 1A to free a place for Russia at the tournament in Alberta, after the Court of Arbitration for Sport ordered Russian teams reinstated. The change is not yet confirmed, and Russia has not been guaranteed Canadian visas.

results.title: Ukraine hits Russia’s second-largest refinery as fuel rationing spreads
results.content: Three main processing units at the KINEF plant which handles about 7% of Russia’s refining capacity and supplies St Petersburg’s Pulkovo airport were damaged. Rosneft separately capped fuel sales in six regions, limiting drivers to 30 litres per transaction in cities.

results.title: British comedian Russell Brand sentenced to 10 years and six months for rape, sexual assault
results.content: The British comedian was found guilty of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault on Thursday following a four-week trial.

results.title: Egypt: Seven dead, 125 injured in collision between two trains
results.content: Rail workers began repairing damaged tracks in Al-Ayyat, Egypt, on Monday 9 November, a day after two passenger trains collided south of Cairo, killing seven people and injuring at least 125 others.

results.title: Philippines: 'Trump out!' Women rally ahead of ASEAN summit
results.content: Women protesters took to the streets of Manila on Monday 9 November ahead of Donald Trump's visit for the 49th ASEAN summit. Carrying "Trump Out" placards, they also denounced a US-led initiative on semiconductors and critical minerals.

results.title: Who is Alice Huang, the alleged Chinese spy linked to Nvidia's Jensen Huang?
results.content: Footage shows Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang alongside Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman at the centre of an alleged Chinese intelligence operation targeting him.

results.title: Trump says US has ‘won’ Iran war as Rubio reports no progress in talks
results.content: The US president said that renewed strikes were unlikely unless Tehran failed to reach a deal, as US forces struck Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran said Washington must end sanctions and the blockade before any talks, while Rubio reported no progress.

results.title: Gaza storm kills five and leaves 70,000 displaced people's tents flooded
results.content: Gaza's rescue service reported five people dead, including three children and two women, in an incident linked to Saturday's storm and heavy rains.

results.title: Russia: HIV spreads beyond risk groups in 27 regions, epidemiologists say
results.content: In 27 regions of the Russian Federation, the immunodeficiency virus is spreading among the entire population, not only risk groups, according to the latest Rospotrebnadzor data. People increasingly pass the virus to one another, often unaware they are infected.

results.title: Trump calls Nvidia chief Jensen Huang an 'honorable guy' amid spy allegations
results.content: US President Donald Trump has defended Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang after reports that he had an intimate relationship with a businesswoman suspected of working for Chinese intelligence. Trump said Huang was an "honorable guy".

results.title: Senegal: Dakar surf school helps young Africans reclaim the waves
results.content: On the beaches of Dakar, a surf school is making the waves accessible to local children. Founder Ibra Samb, who learnt to surf on plywood, hopes to inspire a new generation.

results.title: Argentina: Pope Leo XIV welcomed by Javier Milei for historic visit
results.content: Pope Leo XIV has arrived in Argentina, on Sunday 8 November, for the first papal visit to the country in nearly 40 years. President Javier Milei welcomed him at Buenos Aires airport, while the city's iconic obelisk was illuminated in his honour.

results.title: US President Donald Trump plans to meet Putin and Xi in China next week
results.content: US President Donald Trump said he would possibly meet with Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping in China to discuss "denuclearisation" and how to end the Iran war.

results.title: Nvidia investigates its own CEO Jensen Huang over affair with alleged Chinese spy
results.content: Jensen Huang, CEO of US tech giant Nvidia, is being investigated by the company's board after reports that Huang was the “target of a foreign intelligence effort.” Huang admitted to having an intimate relationship with a business executive who is alleged to have been spying on behalf of China.

results.title: Netherlands: Sea of red fills Amsterdam streets in Gaza protest
results.content: Tens of thousands of people, many dressed in red, marched through Amsterdam in the Netherlands on Sunday 8 November, demanding that the Dutch government take stronger action against Israel over the war in Gaza.

results.title: Poland: Kraków mourns six victims as shooting site reopens
results.content: Kraków's historic main square in southern Poland reopened to the public on Sunday 8 November, just over 24 hours after a deadly shooting left six people dead and 15 others injured. Residents are lighting candles in memory of the victims, while bullet marks remain visible on café windows.

results.title: Pope Leo XIV ends his visit to Uruguay with a tribute to women before departing to Argentina
results.content: Tens of thousands of people packed Florida’s main square for the Mass under brilliant blue skies, some walking for several kilometers to reach the site. The city has a population of about 40,000 but the Vatican estimated 50,000 were attending.

results.title: Overcrowded car plunges into lake in Brazil, killing ten, including five children
results.content: The Rio de Janeiro government confirmed ten dead, including five children. Brazilian media say a baby was among the victims.

results.title: Erdoğan joins Aliyev for Azerbaijan’s Victory Day in Karabakh
results.content: Azerbaijan celebrated on Sunday its sixth Victory Day, marking the end of the Karabakh war. Turkey's Erdoğan joined the commemorations to underscore the strength of bilateral ties despite recent differences, with Aliyev declaring that "this unity will last forever".

results.title: Rosstat hack: data obtained suggests over 390,000 Russian deaths in Ukraine war
results.content: Hacker groups Cyberpartisans BY and Silent Crow say they hacked Rosstat and counted Russian losses since the invasion of Ukraine. Their tally: between 393,000 and 450,000 killed.

results.title: GBU-57 MOP: What to know about the US ‘bunker-buster’ bomb
results.content: The GBU-57, also known as the Massive Ordnance Penetrator, is a 13.6-tonne US bomb designed to destroy deeply buried underground facilities.

results.title: Watch: Spectacular double waterspout forms off Italy's Capri island
results.content: A rare double waterspout formed over Capri's iconic Faraglioni rock formations on Saturday, as heavy clouds gathered above the Italian island.

results.title: At least seven dead, more than 100 injured as two trains collide south of Cairo
results.content: The accident occurred about 52 kilometres south of Cairo, when one train hit the rear of another and one derailed. Egyptian President Abdelfatah al-Sisi has ordered an investigation to determine the causes and responsibility.

results.title: Egypt reopens Tripoli embassy after 12 years and raises concerns over Turkey-Libya maritime deal
results.content: Egypt is seeking closer ties with Libya’s western government after years of backing its eastern rival. Talks in Tripoli covered energy projects and Egypt’s objections to Libya’s maritime deal with Turkey.

results.title: Egypt announces new Mediterranean gas field discovery estimated at 200 billion cubic feet
results.content: The Ministry of Petroleum attributed the positive results to higher investment and exploration activity, noting a better investment climate and progress in settling overdue payments to foreign companies in the energy sector.
